node.title: SOV nonconstant affine character cancellation
node.statement: For any finite-dimensional affine space over the row field, any nontrivial additive character, and any affine-linear coefficient map with nonzero linear part, the nontrivial character sum over the affine space is zero. For a disjoint partition into such affine pieces plus an exceptional set, the total character sum is bounded by the exceptional-set size.
node.attack_surface: finite-field additive-character orthogonality on a nonconstant affine map
node.falsifier: a nonconstant affine-linear map over a finite field whose nontrivial additive character sum is nonzero
